immutable_guards: Publishing remains frozen until explicit production authorization.
The sovereign showrunner BLOCK can never be converted to SHIP by bridge code.
Do not change WEIGHTS, AUTOFAIL_CHECKS, MIN_SCORE, decide_verdict, or fail-closed publish behavior.
Use the same slug and source data for every baseline/shadow comparison.
Adopt only a complete shadow artifact that wins and passes twice.
Rollback immediately on contract drift, missing evidence, regression, or reviewer disagreement.

stop_conditions: Any frozen contract SHA or required symbol changes before Claude begins.
Any baseline/shadow pair changes source data, narration, or slug.
A complete shadow MP4 receives BLOCK, an auto-fail, or a missing verdict.
The two consecutive showrunner verdicts disagree.
A challenger does not beat the incumbent under the existing keep-best rule.
Publishing becomes enabled during preview or migration.
